description: Posts by type, rails, pickets, gates and post-hole concrete from one line: gate openings come off first, corners divide the run, and the hole is counted less the post standing in it. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

bagYield.description: Yield of one bag of the mix you buy, read on its bag: cu ft (imperial) or litres (metric). No default: without it no bag count is given.

gateWidth.description: Gate opening width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 1.2192.

holeDepth.description: Hole depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 60.96.

holeDia.description: Hole diameter. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 25.4.

picketGap.description: Gap between pickets. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 0.

picketWidth.description: Picket width. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 14.

postSide.description: Post side. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 8.89.

pricePicket.description: Price per picket. Unit: $ / picket. Optional.

pricePost.description: Price per post. Unit: $ / post. Optional.

run.description: Fence length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30.48.

spacing.description: Post spacing. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 2.4384.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.
